items.text: The primary purpose of sexuality is:

options.D: Pleasure and enjoyment between consenting people
options.E: A sacred or spiritual dimension of human life

items.text: Is there a "natural" or "correct" purpose for sexuality?

options.B: Yes—pair-bonding is the primary natural function
options.C: Multiple natural purposes exist, none is primary
options.D: No fixed purpose—sexuality is what we make of it
options.E: It transcends biology—sexuality has spiritual dimensions

items.text: Casual sex vs. sex within committed relationships is:

options.A: Casual sex is inferior—intimacy requires commitment
options.B: Committed sex is better but casual isn't necessarily wrong
options.C: Morally equivalent—depends on mutual consent and respect
options.D: Casual sex can be equally meaningful and valid
options.E: The distinction is overstated—all consensual sex is fine
